problems: Pages failed or disambiguation: Yufirid_dynasty returned not-found (Yu'firids used); Kafur, Marwanids and Mazyadid_dynasty are disambiguation pages (Abu_al-Misk_Kafur, Marwanids_(Diyar_Bakr) and Banu_Mazyad used).
Slug renamed to satisfy slugify(name): the Marwanids of Diyar Bakr are marwanids-of-diyar-bakr (not marwanid-dynasty); the Mazyadids are banu-mazyad; uqaylid-dynasty's war belligerents use these.

ikhshidid-dynasty ends 970 (Palestine May, Damascus November) against the infobox 969; rawadid-dynasty ends 1054 (Seljuk conquest) against the page's 900-1071; the Khurramites dossier ends the zone in 837 and the revolt in 838/3.

Cross-dossier conflicts left open and listed in history/polities/_notes/me-08-x.md: Raqqa (Numayrid vs Mirdasid pages), al-Rahba 1008-1061, Edessa 1026-1033, Dvin 948/951, Aleppo 944/947, the abbasid-caliphate 825 loss to the Khurramites being wider than the pages show; hamdanid-emirates (me-08-d) should mirror the Aleppo and Damascus events with ikhshidid-dynasty.

The 15 dossiers rest on 45 page-sources; WebFetch returns a model summary of each page, so quotes in note fields are the fetch tool's quoted sentences, not a raw page copy. No Wikidata ids (wikidata.org unreachable): identity.wikidata is null for all 15.
sharifate-of-mecca, sallarid successors nizari-ismaili-state, atabegs-of-yazd and others are slug-like counterparts with no dossier yet (validator warnings on ikhshidid-dynasty only).
